comment: Every web/uat/*.mjs is either a flow below or listed in excluded with the reason. `node uat/all.mjs --check` fails otherwise, so a new flow cannot be silently left out of CI. Order matters: flows that mark articles read (keyboard) come last. To add a flow to chromium, insert its line above the last entry (never after it) and keep the trailing comma: .gitattributes merges this file by union, so two PRs adding different lines both stay. A new flow adds a line here and nothing else: no npm script in package.json and no eslint line (uat/*.mjs is one glob); run it with `node uat/<name>.mjs`. Fixed sleeps (waitForTimeout) are capped by uat/sleeps.test.mjs: wait for a state instead (waitFor* in common.mjs) and lower its BASELINE when you remove one. knownFail names a flow that is known to fail on one engine: {"<flow>.mjs": {"<engine>": "#<issue>"}}. The value must be an issue number; the flow still runs, a run with findings (exit 1) shows as known and does not fail the run, and a pass fails the run until the entry is removed. Add one entry per line. Keep it empty unless an issue is open.

excluded.common.mjs: shared set-up of the flows, not a flow
excluded.common.test.mjs: unit tests of common.mjs (run by npm test), not a flow
excluded.sleeps.test.mjs: the ratchet on fixed sleeps (run by npm test), not a flow
excluded.statsFixture.mjs: the stand-in summary that stats-screen.mjs answers /api/stats/summary with, not a flow
excluded.summary.mjs: what all.mjs prints under Failures; not a flow
excluded.summary.test.mjs: unit test of summary.mjs (vitest, part of npm test), not a flow
excluded.faults.mjs: tells a browser fault from a finding, for common.mjs; not a flow
excluded.faults.test.mjs: unit test of faults.mjs (vitest, part of npm test), not a flow
excluded.measure-unload-refusal.mjs: reproduces the measurement behind common.mjs unloadRefusal; prints counts, asserts nothing
excluded.probes.mjs: page helpers of run.mjs, not a flow
excluded.wait-ready.mjs: waits for the seeded instance, not a flow
